Representative_Docs: ['Systematic Literature Review of the Use of the Internet of Things IoT in the Health Sector. Currently the Internet of Things IoT is growing rapidly. With its sophisticated technology, IoT is able to provide various positive impacts, such as efficiency, effectiveness and speed in carrying out certain tasks, especially in the health sector. The existence of IoT in the health sector is very important in monitoring patient conditions quickly and practically. The large amount of research on the use of IoT in the health sector can help researchers or related parties in developing IoT in the medical world. Therefore, a literature review is needed regarding the use of IoT in the health sector so that information can be classified systematically. This research aims to identify and analyze the latest research related to the use of IoT in the health sector from 2020 to 2021 using the Systematic Literature Review SLR method with the help of Publish or Perish, Mendeley, Zotero, and Microsoft Excel tools. The research results show that of the 129 IoT articles in Quartile 1 of 2020-2021, there are 10 articles related to IoT in the health sector which are divided into 4 topics, where the most researched topic is the direct impact of IoT in the health sector, with a percentage of 50 , followed by the topic of data transmission efficiency related to the use of IoT in the health sector at 20 , security issues regarding IoT in the health sector at 20 , and the use or use of energy in IoT in the health sector at 10 .', 'Implementation of the balanced scorecard in higher education in Indonesia A systematic literature review. By implementing good education, a country can develop the mindset of its people to be of higher quality and can make that country be seen and taken into account by other countries. The main aim of writing this paper is to find out the extent of the benefits of using a balanced scorecard at a university in Indonesia. Systematic Literature Review is the method used in this research. As time goes by, more and more universities are implementing this balanced scorecard strategy. This balanced scorecard is used as an instrument in measuring the performance of related universities. Of the 23 universities discussed in this paper, 82.61 of them use 4 balanced scorecard perspectives simultaneously. Meanwhile, the rest of the universities only use 3 or even 1 perspective. This is because each university has its own concept or arrangement. Apart from that, there is a lot of literature that shows that the balanced scorecard has various useful values, especially in achieving strategy and improving organizational performance. Based on several studies, the implementation status of the balanced scorecard also shows a minimal failure rate and a relatively high success rate. The use of the balanced scorecard is also useful for universities in knowing their operational performance. With the results of the balanced scorecard, if the value is still not sufficient, the university can further improve its quality, focusing on aspects of the value that are not sufficient.', 'Initiating a Sustainable Food Policy Model Agricultural Transformation in Sub-Urban Areas. The global food system is currently facing increasingly complex multidimensional pressures due to the interaction of ecological, social, economic and political crises. Climate change, land degradation, loss of biodiversity, and inequality in the structure of the food economy have increased the vulnerability of food production systems in various regions. In this context, agroecology is developing as an alternative approach that emphasizes the integration of ecological principles, social sustainability, and strengthening local economies in agricultural systems. This research aims to analyze the role of agroecology in the transformation of sustainable food systems and examine its relevance to local agricultural practices in Indonesia. The research uses a systematic literature review SLR approach by analyzing various international scientific publications, global institutional reports, and academic literature relevant to agroecology and sustainable food systems. The analysis was carried out through identifying main themes which include the global food system crisis, agroecological principles and theoretical framework, developments in agroecological research, local Indonesian agricultural practices, as well as obstacles to the implementation of agroecology. The results of the study show that agroecology has great potential in increasing the resilience of agroecosystems through production diversification, efficient use of resources, and strengthening community institutions. Local agricultural practices in Indonesia such as agroforestry, mixed plantations, subak, and mina padi show strong compatibility with agroecological principles and have the potential to support a more sustainable food system. However, the widespread implementation of agroecology still faces various structural obstacles, including the dominance of external input-based agricultural policies, weak farmer institutions, and limited access to technology and markets. This research shows that agroecology can be an important conceptual framework in transforming the food system towards a more resilient, just and sustainable model through the integration of local knowledge, scientific innovation and inclusive public policies. Key words agroecologist sustainable food systems food system transformation biodiversity-based agriculture. ABSTRACT. Name: 0_knowledge management_knowledge_islamic_learning
Representative_Docs: ['Implementation of server consolidation method on a data center by using virtualization technique a case study. Data center is a place where data and applications placed and run. Those data and applications saved various server based on function of application run such as server of database, proxy, portal, website, application, mikrotic and so on. The more vary application run, the more server types needed. There are several implications when data center encounter server flood, including more electrical energy must be provided. In addition to the relationship between energy and the utilization rate is still low, there is still one problem faced by system administrators with the number of servers in the data center, the more the server to be maintained. The maintenance requirement is usually done as a result of periodic maintenance, hardware upgrades, system upgrades and hardware damage. The maintenance process requires a fairly long time, starts from new server preparation, application and system preparation, and also on the network side. The solution that can be done to solve this situation is by using virtualization VM of the servers. After several processes, such as categorization process, consolidation, design and implementation, the results made are by using VM terms of energy consumption, it can provide a savings of more than 50 . We conduct the virtualization concept on Syarif Hidayatullah State Islamic University of Jakarta UIN Jakarta as our case study. Before VM applied, the consumption of energy used is equal to 7855 watts, whereas after VM applied energy consumption will be 3890 watts. Efficient data center management can be applied and can save time for maintenance. Before the use of the VM, the time required to process improvement at least 3 hours, but after the use of VM takes just less than 1 hour.', 'Evaluation of Digital Sociology on Student Salaf and Modern Islamic Boarding Schools. The current use of digital technology has a lot of influence on human life, especially human sociological aspects, such as patterns of interaction, knitting relationships between individuals, patterns of social behavior relationships, individual attitudes and actions, and so on. The purpose of this research is to find out the digital technology that is in demand and the most widely used by students in modern and salaf Islamic boarding schools and to find out how the influence of digital technology on the social relations of students women with the internal and external environment of the Islamic boarding school. The research was carried out using a quantitative survey and correlational approach to determine the influence of the intensity of use of social media Youtube, Whatsapp, Instagram on social skills in salaf and modern Islamic boarding school students. The sampling technique was random sampling at three Salaf and modern Islamic boarding schools with a sample size of 204. The results of the validity and reliability tests obtained Cronbach s alpha values above 0.6, indicating that the instruments used in the research were valid and reliable. The data analysis technique was carried out using SEM PLS SmartPLS. The results of the research are that there is a relationship between the intensity and duration of social media use by students in Salaf and modern Islamic boarding schools and their level of social skills. This shows that social media usage patterns can influence their ability to interact socially, both positively and negatively.', 'Digital Technology in the Modern Era. The development of digital technology in the last two decades has brought significant transformation in various fields, including theology. This research aims to analyze forms of use of digital technology in the study, practice and dissemination of information about theological doctrines, as well as their implications for the development of spirituality and religious education. Through a descriptive qualitative approach based on literature study, this research identifies that digital technology, such as online learning platforms, digital Bible applications, artificial intelligence AI , and social media, provides access to broader theological knowledge, strengthens faith community interactions, and facilitates more flexible learning models. However, the author also highlights emerging challenges, including the risk of theological misinformation, reduced or even lost depth of spiritual reflection, and over-reliance on technology. This makes the author interested in discussing the topic of the role of digital technology in the era of modern theology. The results of this research show that the use of digital technology in modern theology brings great opportunities for the development of knowledge and practice of faith, but still requires a critical and ethical approach to remain in harmony with correct theological foundations.']

Name: 1_acceptance_intention_user acceptance_utaut
Representative_Docs: ['Behavioral intention analysis of distance education system using the innovation diffusion theory and technology acceptance model. The Distance Education System DES is a learning system by using online application facilities through internet that rapidly adopted in the education sector. However, there has been many obstacles and problems that hinder learning activities. It has been implemented in all level of education in Indonesia even more during pandemic Covid-19. DES is one of the innovations that have been adopted in education sector, hence its kind of technology can influence the intention of learning. The purpose of this study is to measure an individual perception on behavioural intention to use of Distance Education Systems DES in the province of DKI Jakarta area. Researchers used a combination of the Technology Acceptance Model TAM and Innovation Diffusion Theory IDT research models. The sampling technique used is purposive sampling, which only selects the students of Islamic Junior high school Madrasah Aliyah Negeri MAN in the province of DKI Jakarta area. The data analysis method used is PLS-SEM with the product software of SmartPLS 3.3.3. The results of the study indicate that 8 out of 13 hypotheses are accepted. The variable that has the greatest influence on behavioural intention to use is compatibility mediated by perceived usefulness. The results found that three IDT variables relative advantages, complexity, trialability have a significant effect on the perceived usefulness variable, then lead to it has a significant relationship on behavioral intention to use. In addition, the two of IDT variable namely compatibility and trialability have significant effect on the perceived ease of use then it has a significant effect on behavioral intention to use. The study found that the behavioural intention to use of DES influenced by the innovation characteristics IDT and mediated by the characteristics of technology itself TAM .', 'Switching Behavior Analysis of E-Government Application Using the Extended UTAUT Model. To improve population administration services, the government has developed an e-government initiative in the form of a Digital Population Identity IKD application. IKD is a solution to the process of making a physical E-KTP Electronic Population Card which takes quite a long time. Although the government has set a target of 25 of E-KTP holders activating IKD in 2023, the realization is only around 3.3 who have activated it. Based on these conditions, it is necessary to examine the factors that influence IKD application users to switch from E-KTP to the IKD application using the Extended Unified Theory of Acceptance and Use of Technology UTAUT model. The population of this study was IKD application users in Java, with a total of 406 respondents selected through a proportional stratified random samplingtechnique. Data analysis was carried out using the PLS-SEM approach with SmartPLS version 4.1. The results of the study showed six variables that significantly influenced user behaviorto switch from E-KTP to IKD. Namely the variables of performance expectations, social influence, perceived risk, perceived security and privacy, trust, and intention to switch. In contrast, expectations of effort, supportive conditions, and government support did not have a significant effect. The variables of perceived security and privacy showed the highest significance, with a t-test value of 54.339 and a p-value of 0.000,while the variable of government support showed the smallest impact, with a t-test value of 0.354 and a p-value of 0.723. These findings can provide direction for Dukcapil to improve the implementation and increase public acceptance of the IKD application.', 'Factors Influencing the Continuance Intention of Telemedicine Application Usage Using the Extended Expectation Confirmation Model EECM . Telemedicine services have grown rapidly alongside advances in information technology and the increasing need for convenient and fast access to healthcare services. Telemedicine enables users to conduct online medical consultations without physically visiting healthcare facilities. Halodoc is one of the most popular telemedicine platforms in Indonesia, offering various digital health services such as doctor consultations, medication purchases, and laboratory testing. However, user retention remains a challenge, as not all users continue using the application in the long term. This study aims to test and develop the Expectation Confirmation Model ECM by adding two external variables service quality and self-efficacy to explain users continuance intention in using the Halodoc application. A quantitative approach was employed using a survey method with questionnaires. A sample of 209 respondents was selected through non-probability sampling with a purposive sampling approach, focusing on active Halodoc users in the Jabodetabek area. Data analysis was conducted using PLS-SEM with the SmartPLS software. The results show that the Extended Expectation Confirmation Model EECM used in this study is valid and effective in explaining the continuance usage of the Halodoc application. The variables of perceived usefulness, satisfaction, service quality, and self-efficacy significantly influence continuance use intention, with service quality being the most dominant variable. The study proposed nine hypotheses, of which seven were accepted and two rejected. The rejected hypotheses were the effects of confirmation on satisfaction and service quality on satisfaction, which were found to be insignificant due to t-statistic values below the threshold. These findings are expected to serve as a reference for future studies on the adoption of telemedicine health service technologies.']

Representative_Docs: ['Design and build of an e-commerce based goods sales information system case study pt. Sandy is sustainable', 'Forecasting the Inventory of Milled Dry Grain Using the Lot Sizing Method at Markom Rice Mill. Today s industrial activities are increasing with sophisticated technology, all applied to satisfy consumers in various services. One of the important parts of an industry is the inventory of goods. This is related to the continuity of the resulting production. In meeting the needs of consumers, a plan is needed in production so that there is no shortage of raw materials and the production process does not stop. Grain is an agricultural commodity whose demand and production levels occasionally increase. We can see that until now, our country, Indonesia, still imports rice from other countries, where rice is the main production product produced from grain. The problem can be solved with the Lot sizing method used in this study, which is used to determine the size of the order quantity. In the rice mill itself, grain storage has a limited capacity, so it cannot be directly stored with a large capacity when the price of grain is down. Applying this method as an application will make it easier to manage grain inventory at the rice mill and estimate inventory costs for the next 1 year. The results of the lot sizing calculation silver meal show that for the next year, the smallest cost of procurement of dry milled grain MDG demand is obtained from the procurement of demand every month. In other words, procurement is more appropriate every month or period so that the costs incurred for grain inventory are smaller. The following data are the results of the silver meal lot sizing calculation 1 39015.4 kg, 2 35871.2 kg, 3 39536 kg, 4 33894.8 kg, 5 31402 kg, 6 27982.5 kg, 7 41461.9 kg, 8 35336.7 kg, 9 41305.6 kg, 10 45717.5 kg, 11 42007.9 kg, 12 50828 kg. The cost incurred per order is Rp. 6,000,000', 'Analysis and development of digital marketing strategies at LKP Ilma Modeste using the Sostac method. This research aims to examine the digital marketing information system strategy implemented by CV. AUFCO in developing their electronic trading business by implementing the SOSTAC method. The SOSTAC method is used as a guideline for developing and implementing digital marketing strategies, which include the stages of Specification, Objectives, Strategy, Tactics, Action and Control. This research uses a descriptive qualitative approach by collecting primary data through in-depth interviews with related parties at AUFCO. The research results reveal that AUFCO has succeeded in implementing effective digital marketing strategies to increase revenue, expand markets and increase customer satisfaction. The use of SOSTAC helps AUFCO in formulating targeted business objectives, determining the right target market, and developing efficient marketing tactics. Evaluation of strategy implementation shows that AUFCO has succeeded in achieving most of the targets set, although there are still obstacles in facing tight business competition and changes in unstable economic conditions. This research contributes ideas in deepening understanding of the application of SOSTAC in the context of electronic commerce, as well as providing suggestions for other business actors who are interested in adopting a similar strategy.']

Name: 3_usability_satisfaction_user_user satisfaction
Representative_Docs: ['Evaluation and Improvement of User Interface Design for Kiniku Mall Application Using Usability Testing Method and Human Centered Design HCD Approach. In the midst of rapid advances in technology and internet use, the National Narcotics Agency BNN as a government agency has built a website for the purposes of disseminating information and accelerating communication for the wider community. This research focuses on evaluating and improving the user interface of the official BNN website using Usability Testing and the Human-Centered Design HCD approach. HCD is an approach to developing interactive systems with the aim of making the system usable and useful. Usability testing is the process of testing a website to determine ease of use by users. The research stages start from user identification, user needs analysis, initial design usability testing evaluation, solution design creation, and solution design usability testing evaluation. The research results show that by using the HCD method there is an increase in usability in the aspects of effectiveness and efficiency from the initial design of 96 to 100 in the solution design. Apart from that, the average processing time was also faster from 45.28 seconds for the initial design to 9.36 seconds for the solution design.', 'Student perceptions of user satisfaction and user loyalty of website based e-learning. This paper discusses the importance of information technology development in facilitating human life through website-based e-learning. E-learning accelerates the dissemination of knowledge, particularly during the Covid-19 pandemic when online learning surged. However, users encounter challenges, such as unclear task instructions and platform errors. This research aims to enhance the quality of e-learning services by analyzing students perceptions of user satisfaction and loyalty on three major e-learning platforms in Indonesia. The study employs the EUCS model augmented with System Quality dimensions. Respondents are middle and high school students in DKI Jakarta who have used one of the e-learning platforms. The results from 209 respondents indicate high user satisfaction, scoring 85.93, and a high level of user loyalty, scoring 84.69. Factors such as Content, Format, Ease of use, Timeliness, Instructor quality, and Course Materials show a positive relationship with user satisfaction, with Course Materials being the most influential. However, hypotheses regarding Accuracy, Administrative and support service quality, and Security and privacy did not prove to have a significant impact. This research is expected to expand the understanding of factors influencing user satisfaction and loyalty in website-based e-learning and provide guidance for improving the quality of e-learning to enhance student satisfaction and loyalty.', 'Analysis of user satisfaction of the DKI Jakarta regional revenue agency Coretax application using the end user computing satisfaction EUCS method. The National Signal application, which will be held in Pekanbaru on August 25, 2021. Problems with the National Signal Samsat also often occur to some users of the National Signal application. The application requires a measurement of thelevel of end user satisfaction, so that it can find out the condition of application user satisfaction. While the other 4 variables have a high percentage of satisfaction with an average of 72-82 . And the results of the T test where the hypothesis on the accuracy variable section is rejected because there is no effect on users of the National Signal Application. Based on the overall results of the research, it can be seen that users of the National Signal application are satisfied withthe performance of the application with the highest score from the results of filling out the questionnaire from 222 samples which state that the National Signal Application is a complete information provider for paying the SAMSAT tax.']

Name: 4_classification_indonesian_algorithm_news
Representative_Docs: ['Application of machine learning as an instrument for enforcing digital communication ethics in mitigating the spread of fake news. The rapid spread of disinformation in the digital era poses a systemic threat to communication ethics, overwhelming manual verification capacities. This study aims to develop and evaluate an automatic text classification model using Machine Learning as a preventive instrument to mitigate fake news and uphold public information rights. Employing a quantitative experimental approach, the study compared five classification algorithmsLogistic Regression, Multinomial Naive Bayes, Linear SVC, Random Forest, and Passive Aggressiveusing TF-IDF vectorization on a dataset of 6,335 news articles. Model evaluation prioritized the F1-Score and False Positive metrics to address ethical risks. The results demonstrated that the Linear Support Vector Classification Linear SVC outperformed other models, achieving the highest F1-Score of 93.67 and an accuracy of 93.76 . Crucially, the Linear SVC model recorded a minimal False Positive rate, misclassifying only 30 fake articles. This indicates its reliability and ethical accountability as an algorithmic filter. The study concludes that Linear SVC is highly effective for fake news mitigation, though human digital literacy remains the ultimate defense.', 'Aspect-based sentiment analysis on Tangerang Live application reviews using latent Dirichlet allocation and Naive Bayes. The public complaint service system is an important means for the city government to receive, process and follow up on various citizen complaints. However, the increasing volume of complaint data in the city of Surabaya has become a challenge due to less effective manual management. In-depth analysis of complaint data is needed to understand public opinion on service quality. This research aims to carry out aspect-based sentiment analysis of complaint data. The research was conducted using the Latent Dirichlet Allocation LDA method to identify the main aspects of complaints and using Multinomial Naive Bayes MNB to classify sentiment. The data used consists of 10,847 complaints collected via the WargaKu application and Media Center throughout 2023. The LDA method succeeded in identifying 17 main topics, including administration, infrastructure and public information. Furthermore, the MNB Model achieved 80 accuracy after applying resampling, proving its reliability in sentiment classification. The research results provide relevant insights to help city governments prioritize improvements on key issues and offer approaches that similar complaint systems can adopt', 'Sentiment analysis in smart city application reviews using latent dirichlet allocation modeling and naive Bayes classification. AbstractThe National Non-Cash Movement GNNT launched by Bank Indonesia has encouraged significant growth in the use of e-wallets as a means of digital payment. ShopeePay is one of the dominant platforms with market penetration reaching 68 . This research aims to analyze user sentiment towards the ShopeePay application and interpret the dominant sentiment topics in user reviews. The method used is sentiment analysis with the Naive Bayes algorithm and topic modeling using Latent Dirichlet Allocation LDA based on Google Play Store review data for the period JanuaryDecember 2024. The analysis results show a model accuracy of 89.70 with precision of 82 , recall of 86 , and F1-score of 84 . Of the 2,811 preprocessed reviews, the model predicted 2,183 reviews were positive, while 628 reviews were negative. Topic analysis revealed that users were satisfied with transaction ease, system reliability and service quality with a coherence of 0.5157 in topic group 7, while the main complaints were related to technical issues with accounts and loan services with a coherence value of 0.3453 in topic group 10. These findings provide recommendations for developers to improve service quality regarding handling technical issues and loan features. Keywords ShopeePay, Naive Bayes, Latent Dirichlet Allocation, Sentiment analysis']

Name: 5_strategic_project_review_literature review
Representative_Docs: ['Success model for measuring information system implementation Literature review. Many researchers have done research on information systems before this is because of the breadth of studies or topics about IS. There is some example of a study on how to measure Information System Success by testing instrument factors. Some researchers can produce different judgments regarding the success of implementation of IS this is because the first definition of success of each researcher is changed, the two perspectives on success assessment, the three variables used, the four implementations in different environments. Several models can be used as references to assess the success of IS, Delone and McLean are examples that are widely used as references, which use six variables in measuring IS implementation. From the model used, later there will be a gap in determining the model, and this becomes an opportunity for the development of the model as follows. The development of models to measure information system success can be done by adoption, adaptation, and combination. This is legitimately valid as long as the development of the model is accompanied by supporting theories. The purpose of this review literature is especially researchers can provide an overview of related to the method of previous researchers. Then it can be used as a framework for solving problems.', 'Readiness factors for information system strategic planning among universities in developing countries A systematic review. The implementation of information system strategic planning ISSP in higher education institutions is to improve work efficiency, management effectiveness in order to improve organizational competitive advantage. However, the question of whether all universities are ready to implement ISSP as a way to achieve organizational goals has not been answered. This study aims to investigate the readiness phenomena through literature study. The method used is by using the Systematic Literature Review SLR instrument to identify readiness factors on the implementation of ISSP, especially among the institutions of higher education in developing countries. This study has identified 10 readiness measurement. There are three categories of measurement, namely people, processes and technologies that represent 11 factors of ISSP readiness measurement in universities.', 'Utilization of the Hot-Fit Model to Measure the Success of Information Systems a Literature Review. The Human-Organization-Technology Fit HOTFit Model has been widely used in evaluating the success of information system IS implementation and adoption across various sectors. This research aims to systematically review ten scientific journal articles that utilized the HOT-Fit model in diverse contexts, such as hospitals, government, industry, and education. Employing a Systematic Literature Review SLR approach, this article identifies trends, gaps, and contributions of the HOT-Fit model in supporting the evaluation and decisionmaking related to information systems. The analysis results indicate that human and organizational factors often serve as key determinants of IS success. This research also recommends integrating HOT-Fit with other evaluation methods to enhance the accuracy of evaluation results.']

Name: 6_decision_decision support_employee_support
Representative_Docs: ['Decision Support Systems. Advances in digital transformation have had an impact on the complexity of decision-making processes in various sectors, especially with the increasing volume of large and varied data. In this context, efficient tools are needed to evaluate multi-criteria alternatives objectively. Simple Additive Weighting SAW has emerged as one of the methods that is widely used in Decision Support Systems DSS . However, systematic studies discussing the development and application of this method in various contexts are still very limited. This research aims to conduct a Systematic Literature Review SLR on the development of SAW-based SPK with a focus on identifying application platforms, design methods and benefits of implementation. In this research, the Systematic Literature Review method was used with an approach that follows Kitchenham s guidelines. The research results show that web-based platforms dominate DSS development because of their flexibility, ease of access, and ability to support real-time decision making. In addition, the Prototyping design method is often used because it allows dynamic adjustment of the system to user needs. The application of the SAW method has consistently been proven to increase accuracy, time efficiency, transparency and user confidence in the decision-making process.', 'Design and build a savings transaction system for web-based waste management Case study Sahitya Waste Bank, Faculty of Science and Technology, UIN Syarif Hidayatullah Jakarta . Sahitya Waste Bank is an organization initiated by DEMA FST which is intended for all students of UIN Syarif Hidayatullah Jakarta to support the management of inorganic waste into valuable goods thereby creating additional income. The increasing number of customers in all faculties has caused treasurers to be overwhelmed in ordering the ranking of customers and have not been on target in determining the best customers with the same weight of waste. Apart from that, there is no system security in handling the transaction process so that unwanted access can occur. The aim of this research is to develop a savings transaction system for waste management in the faculty to make UINSyarif Hidayatullah Jakarta Green Campus. The decision making method uses Simple AdditiveWeighting SAW . The system development methodology used is Rapid Application Development RAD . The tools used in system design are Unified Modeling Language UML . The implementation of this system uses the PHP programming language with the Laravel and MySQL framework as database processing. The resulting system can simplify and speed up the process of recording and managing waste bank data.', 'Fuzzy Analytical Hierarchy Process Approach in Coffee Shop Location Decision Support Systems. One of the main challenges in distributing zakat is the limited funds available compared to the number of applications for assistance which continues to increase. This condition causes institutions such as BAZNAS to carry out strict selection and determine priorities for aid recipients fairly. In an effort to answer these problems, this research developed a Decision Support System DSS using a combination of Random Forest and Fuzzy Analytical Hierarchy Process F-AHP methods. The Random Forest method is used to classify the eligibility of prospective zakat recipients based on five main criteria, namely income, number of dependents, residence status, history of receiving aid, and nominal application. Meanwhile, the Fuzzy Analytical Hierarchy Process F-AHP is used to determine the priority level of candidates who have been declared eligible. This research uses data from BAZNAS Bandung City, which was collected through observation and interviews. The evaluation results show that the Random Forest model built has an accuracy rate of 88.98 , with precision and recall each above 93 , indicating high classification performance. Furthermore, the Fuzzy Analytical Hierarchy Process F-AHP weighting process produces a dominant weight for the income criterion of 0.408, followed by residence status and number of dependents. This system has succeeded in assisting the selection and ranking process of prospective zakat recipients objectively, efficiently and transparently. With this approach, it is hoped that zakat managers can optimize zakat distribution according to priorities to those in need.']

Name: 7_sharia_halal_financial_islamic
Representative_Docs: ['The resilience of Sharia and conventional banks in Indonesia during the Covid-19 pandemic crisis', 'National Sharia Council Fatwas on Islamic Legal Aspects of Sharia Banking in Indonesia', 'Sharia Banking Information System. This research reviews Digital Transformation in Sharia Banking Information Systems. This research aims to explore the challenges and opportunities faced by Islamic financial institutions in adopting digital transformation, with a focus on the social and economic impacts on Muslim communities. The methodology used is a qualitative descriptive approach through literature study to collect and analyze data from various trusted sources, which involves analysis of literature related to the development of information technology-based sharia banking. The results show that the digitalization of Islamic banking has brought significant changes in the operations of financial institutions, with an emphasis on fairness and profits in financial transactions. In addition, this transformation improves customer experience through personalization of services, expanding financial inclusion and increasing public financial literacy which in turn encourages active participation in the sharia financial system. However, challenges such as policy, integration and technical regulations need to be addressed to ensure the success of this transformation and customer protection.']

Name: 8_spatial_distribution_modeling language_unified modeling
Representative_Docs: ['Design and development of a web-based spatial information system for the distribution of tourism potential in Bogor district', 'Design and Development of a Web-Based Spatial Information System for the Distribution of Social Homes Case Study DKI Jakarta', 'Development of web-based spatial information system tourism industry event distribution case study . In recent years, the number and scope of events in the Asia and Middle East North Africa region has increased significantly. Events are one of the things that attracts the attention of foreign tourists to come to visit a country as a tourist destination. Refers toMinister of Tourism Regulation Number 2 Year 2017on Guidelines for Venues for Meetings, Incentive Trips, Conventions and Exhibitions, explains that criteria and indicators are needed to increase the competitiveness of venues for meetings, incentive trips, conventions and exhibitions at the regional and global levels. This is done to increase the number of visits, length of stay, and expenditures for domestic and foreign tourists. Therefore, visual indicators or data are needed that can present the location of the event and a list of events in DKI Jakarta. From these problems, this study aims to produce a web-based spatial information system for the distribution of tourism industry events to map event locations in DKI Jakarta. The methodology used in collecting this data is the method of observation, interviews, and literature studies. While the system development methodology uses PHP and MySQL with the Rapid Application Development RAD approach and uses the Unified Modeling Language UML which is a tool for system description and design, as well as the Google Maps API for digital maps.
